hours.title: Hours
hours.lead: Dine-in hours as printed on their home page. Takeout uses a different window — see Takeout.
hours.change: Hours are subject to change, please call to inquire.
hours.book: Reservations are not required but are recommended. Call (613) 592-0225.
hours.parties: Parties of 10 or more: email events@fratelli-kanata.ca.
hours.westboro: fratelli.ca is Fratelli Westboro at 275 Richmond Road, with OpenTable. That is not this room.

takeout.title: Takeout
takeout.lead: We only accept orders via phone, (613) 592-0225. If the line is busy, try again. We do not invent an online cart.
takeout.hoursLead: Printed on their takeout page — not the same as dine-in.
takeout.openHours: They also write that takeout is available during open hours, then print this window.
takeout.beer: Beer and wine are also available for takeout.
takeout.pickup: Standard pickup is 15–20 minutes for most orders; some take longer. Orders can be pre-ordered up to an hour prior to pickup.
takeout.pay: They print cash, Interact, credit cards including American Express, and payment over the phone if you ask when ordering.
takeout.deadLink: Their takeout page still points at kanata.fratelli.ca /menu2020. That path 404s, and kanata.fratelli.ca now redirects to Fratelli Westboro. We do not send you there for this kitchen.
takeout.covid: That takeout page still carries 2020 pickup-area notes. We keep the phone-order rule; we do not treat mask language as current house policy.

events.title: Events
events.lead: Looking to host a business lunch or dinner, a wedding shower or rehearsal dinner? They have an exclusive hosting space in the upstairs loft.
events.seats: The loft seats up to 32 people for seated lunches and dinners.
events.menus: They offer a variety of set menus and specialty menu items for groups. We do not invent those menus.
events.email: Email the event team at events@fratelli-kanata.ca.
events.gratuity: Groups of 8 or more are subject to an automatic gratuity of 20%.
events.cake: Outside desserts will be subject to a plating fee reflective of the group’s size. They do not print a dollar amount — neither do we.

about.title: About
about.glebe: Established in 1996 in the Glebe, their vision was a neighbourhood restaurant with good Italian food, good wine, and friendly service in an unpretentious atmosphere. Robert and mother Louisa ran the kitchen; Richard and father Pasquale worked the dining room.
about.kanata: They continue the tradition as fratelli at the Kanata location — family-owned and operated.
about.roberto: They also point to Roberto Pizza in Little Italy. That is a different site. We link it; we do not rebuild it as this room.
about.notWestboro: This rebuild is fratellikanata.ca only — 499 Terry Fox Drive. Not 275 Richmond Road.

contact.title: Contact
contact.lead: Call the restaurant. Email is for events and parties of 10 or more — not a booking form.
contact.noForm: There is no reservation form on their live site. There is none here.

footer.line: Vino × pasta × pizza. A rebuild of fratellikanata.ca — their live Squarespace stays until they switch.
